title: 開放状態の屋上出入口
description: 開いた断熱蓋、中空の立ち上がり枠、ヒンジ、支持ステー、ハンドルを備える人用屋上ハッチ。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: An open personnel roof hatch with hollow coaming, insulated lid, hinges, gas stays and pull handle. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
